mapper.sql: id, organization_id, email, role_code, token_hash, status, expires_at, accepted_at, accepted_by, created_by, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_invitation (organization_id, email, role_code, token_hash, status, expires_at, accepted_at, accepted_by, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{organizationId}, #{email}, #{roleCode}, #{tokenHash}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{acceptedAt}, #{acceptedBy}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM organization_invitation WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND email = #{email} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM organization_invitation WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
